pages: Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands at the crib room wall with one hand flat on a linen-backed plan sheet pinned up in brown ink. Middle: a rolled print tied with string, a steel tape hook on the desk. Background: a bare wooden room, a low window, morning.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, writes on one folded tally sheet held flat on the desk, a pencil in his right hand. Middle: a steel tape coiled on the floor, an enamel mug. Background: drill collars stacked on a bench, the crib room window. Early light.

Ruben Barrow, fifties, a grey work jacket, leans over one unrolled plan print on the crib room desk, one finger down on a station mark. Middle: a steel tape and its case, a hard hat on the desk. Background: the opposite wall with the older plan, window light across the paper.

Ruben Barrow, fifties, a grey work jacket, stands at the bench with his hand flat on one grey measuring machine with a red window in its end. Middle: a wide-brimmed hat on the desk, a rolled plan tied with string. Background: the crib room doorway, dust turning in the window light.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, pushes one rubber-tyred measuring wheel on a long handle along the flat floor of the drive, a steel tape laid beside it. Middle: the tape hook, a thermos on the wall rib. Background: limestone walls, a helmet lamp glow.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, marks the wall rib with one stub of blue chalk, a stopwatch swinging on a lanyard at his chest. Middle: chalk crosses spaced along the rib, the measuring wheel stood on end. Background: the long straight drive, lamplight.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands square to the rock face, mouth open in a shout, one thumb over a stopwatch in his raised hand. Middle: his scuffed boot, a chalk cross on the rib. Background: the rough grey face, hard lamplight.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, shouts down the twenty-metre span of the drive, one stopwatch held up before his face. Middle: the steel tape stretched along the floor, blue chalk marks on the rib. Background: the far end of the drive in dark.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands side-on with one eye on a hammer head swinging down the drive, a stopwatch pinched in his other hand. Middle: blue chalk crosses on the rib, the tape reel on the floor. Background: the drive receding into lamp glow.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, leans toward the 110 face mid-shout, one stopwatch raised at his chest. Middle: loose rubble heaped underfoot, a chalk cross on the wall rib. Background: the rough grey face, lamplight lying along the wet stone floor.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands still with his head cocked to one side, a stopwatch flat in his open palm, listening. Middle: wet rubble at his boots, the chalked rib. Background: the dark mouth of the face, his helmet lamp.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, sets one geology hammer against the rock face low down, round end forward, his other palm flat on the stone. Middle: a crack running above his head, dust on the floor. Background: the ribbed limestone wall, lamplight.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands in the crib room doorway holding one folded tally sheet out in front of him. Middle: a desk with a hard hat on it, a chair. Background: the plan pinned to the wall, morning through the window.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, kneels on the rubble floor with one hand on a drill collar set in the rock. Middle: a steel bit lying to one side, the folded tally sheet. Background: the low roof of the drive, lamp glow.

Hori Kere, forties, dark stubble, a blue drill singlet with a rag over one shoulder, stands in the crib room reading one tally sheet held in both hands. Middle: a paper invoice turned over on a crate, a pencil. Background: the wall of plans behind him, flat cold morning light.

Tam, seventeen, a knitted beanie and an orange hi-vis vest, crouches behind the cab of one yellow wheel loader, one hand gripping the step rail. Middle: a long ridge of broken rock down the middle of the bay floor, a dirt berm. Background: the long drive, low dusty light and stone dust.

Ruben Barrow, fifties, a grey work jacket, kneels on the ramp writing in one survey book braced on his knee. Middle: a steel tape and a ranging rod stuck upright in the dust, loader tracks in the gravel. Background: the quarry face above the bay, cold morning light on the spoil.

Ruben Barrow, fifties, a grey work jacket, draws one firm rule under two figures on a large plan sheet spread flat on the desk. Middle: a pen uncapped, the older plan rolled and tied with string. Background: the crib room window, flat daylight, a film of dust on the sill.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, pins one old linen-backed plan sheet back up on the wall beside the new print. Middle: a roll of blue paper, drawing pins in a tin. Background: the crib room and a bare desk, window daylight.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, stands at the far end of the straight drive with one hand on the rib, looking across black water in the old level. Middle: chalk marks on the wall, a lamp on the rib. Background: the drive going away into dark, damp light.

Wiremu, fourteen, short black hair, an orange hi-vis vest over a grey wool jersey, holds one survey book open in both hands, a pencil lying across the open leaves. Middle: the crib room desk, a rubber weight on the shelf. Background: two plan sheets pinned to the wall, quiet daylight.
